name: mcal_list_invites
description: List event invites the user has received from OTHER people — matched to their Metalcraft account email, so these are events on someone else's calendar that they were added to as a guest. Returns upcoming invites (soonest first), including ones already answered. Takes no arguments. Each invite has: event_id (UUID — pass to mcal_respond_invite), title, location, timezone (IANA — convert starts_at/ends_at from UTC when reporting), organizer_email (who invited them), calendar_name, starts_at, ends_at (UTC ISO-8601), rsvp ('pending'|'accepted'|'declined'), meet_join_url (video link if any, else null), invited_at (UTC ISO-8601 — when the invite arrived; sort by this to surface the most RECENT invites), and on_my_calendar (true once accepted — the shared event then appears on the user's read-only 'Invitations' calendar; it is not a copy). Use this to answer 'do I have any invites?' and to get the event_id needed to accept or decline.
